debrief db-021

2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-p-p-l-i-e-d f-a-k-e c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n m-a-r-k-s t-o t-h-e p-a-c-k-a-g-i-n-g, l-e-f-t i-n-s-p-e-c-t-a-b-l-e b-r-a-n-d-i-n-g m-a-t-e-r-i-a-l-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-l-a-b-e-l-e-d a-g-e w-a-r-n-i-n-g-s t-o s-h-i-f-t l-i-a-b-i-l-i-t-y f-o-r d-a-n-g-e-r-o-u-s u-s-e, l-e-f-t m-i-s-l-a-b-e-l-e-d u-n-i-t-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d h-a-z-a-r-d c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-c-c-e-l-e-r-a-t-e-d i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y s-h-i-p-m-e-n-t-s b-e-f-o-r-e r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r y a-c-t-i-o-n, l-e-f-t e-x-p-e-d-i-t-e-d l-o-g-i-s-t-i-c-s r-e-c-o-r-d-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d s-t-o-p o-r-d-e-r c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e c-h-e-c-k-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-p-o-s-e-d o-f o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l t-e-s-t r-e-c-o-r-d-s t-o p-r-e-v-e-n-t d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n, l-e-f-t g-a-p-p-e-d a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l-s.
